name: Examination Cell (Office of the Controller of Examinations)
responsibilities: Conducting semester and annual university examinations
Issuance of marksheets, transcripts, and provisional certificates
Correction of typographical and name errors on marksheets
Duplicate marksheet and degree verification processing
Resolution of exam form submission and fee portal glitches
commonStudentProblems: Marksheet mein naam ya roll number galat print ho gaya
Exam form submit nahi ho raha ya fee debit hone ke baad pending dikha raha hai
Provisional degree certificate ya migration certificate chahiye
Back paper / ATKT form submission
location: Examination Building (Pariksha Bhawan), Near Main Administrative Block
officeHours: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 5:30 PM (Lunch: 1:30 PM - 2:00 PM)

name: Dean of Students' Welfare (DSW Office)
responsibilities: Student welfare programs, co-curricular and cultural activities
Facilitation and verification of State and National Scholarships
Student grievance assistance and welfare counseling
Hostel accommodation guidance and coordination
Student ID card approvals and bonafide certification endorsements
commonStudentProblems: Scholarship ka paisa nahi aaya / portal par pending dikha raha hai
Hostel allotment process and verification
General student grievance or assistance
Bonafide certificate ya student railway concession
location: DSW Building, Campus Road (Opposite Student Activity Centre)

name: University Scholarship & Fellowship Cell
responsibilities: Processing and verification of MP Post-Matric Scholarship (MP Taas portal)
National Scholarship Portal (NSP) institutional level verification
UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) & Non-NET fellowship claims
Disbursement tracking and endorsement of scholarship renewal forms
commonStudentProblems: Meri scholarship nahi aayi, portal par university verification pending hai
MP Taas ya NSP renewal form approve karwana hai
Scholarship ke liye income certificate / caste verification
location: Administrative Block, Room No. 12 / DSW Section

name: Academic Section (Registrar Office)
responsibilities: University enrollment, course registration, and student ID generation
Issuance of Migration Certificates, Transfer Certificates (TC), and Character Certificates
Academic calendar formulation and university regulations
Degree conferral and convocation documentation
commonStudentProblems: Migration certificate chahiye dusri university mein admission ke liye
Course registration ya enrollment number generate nahi hua
Degree certificate dispatch verification

name: Finance & Accounts Branch
responsibilities: Fee reconciliation for online admission and semester portal payments
Processing fee refunds and double payment chargebacks
Issuing official fee clearance receipts and challan verification
commonStudentProblems: Bank account se fee kat gayi lekin portal par 'unpaid' dikha raha hai
Double fee payment ho gayi, refund ke liye application dena hai
Fee payment receipt download nahi ho rahi

name: University Health Centre (Medical Facility)
responsibilities: Primary health care, OPD consultations and essential medicines for students & staff
Emergency first aid and 24x7 ambulance dispatch
Annual student medical check-ups and health fitness endorsements
commonStudentProblems: Health issue / emergency medical aid on campus
Free doctor consultation and basic medicines
Hostel medical fitness certificate
location: University Health Centre Building, Near Boys Hostels Complex

name: Hostel Administration & Chief Warden Office
hindiName: छात्रावास प्रशासन एवं मुख्य संरक्षक कार्यालय
responsibilities: Hostel room allotment and merit list verification for boys & girls hostels
Hostel mess management and sanitation supervision
Hostel fee clearance and room handover / no-dues verification
commonStudentProblems: Hostel admission merit list kab aayegi
Hostel room allotment letter aur fee receipt jama karna hai
Hostel change request ya room maintenance issue
location: Hostel Office Complex, Tagore Hostel premises

name: Chief Proctor & Anti-Ragging Committee
responsibilities: Maintaining discipline, campus safety and zero tolerance against ragging
24x7 Anti-ragging helpline coordination and incident redressal
Campus security monitoring and grievance resolution
commonStudentProblems: Campus safety concern or ragging incident complaint
Disciplinary inquiry clarification
Anti-ragging affidavit verification
